sentences.en: In the village there was hunger that year.
There was not enough food for everyone.
Juha bought bread for three days.
He put it in the cupboard in the house.
In the evening a guest came to him.
The guest was very hungry.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא נתן לו את לחם היום.
sentences.en: Juha gave him the day’s bread.
The guest ate everything and said thank you.
In the morning a second guest came.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא נתן לו את לחם המחר.
sentences.en: Juha gave him tomorrow’s bread.
In the evening a third guest came.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא נתן לו את הלחם האחרון.
sentences.en: Juha gave him the last bread.
His wife said: what shall we eat now?
Juha sat and did not answer her.
In the morning they knocked at the door again.
Juha opened, and a man stood there.

sentences.ar: לאיש היה שק גדול על הגב.
sentences.en: The man had a big sack on his back.
The man said: you are Juha, right?
He said: I ate at your house once.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: היום יש לי הרבה.
sentences.en: He said: today I have a lot.

sentences.ar: הוא שם את השק על הרצפה והלך.
sentences.en: He put the sack on the floor and went.
Juha said to his wife: do you see?
